<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/api/delete_workflow/{project_guid}/{workflow_guid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Deletes a workflow's directory from the project's hub, removes its
entry from the project config and its saved node positions, commits and
propagates the change to every clone, and schedules a runtime reload as
a background task.
